name: sms-message-field
title: SMS message field
description: A text message box that counts messages, not characters, and names the emoji or curly quote that turns one message into several.
docs: value and onValueChange(value, count) speak the message and what it costs. One message holds 160 characters in the standard GSM alphabet and 70 as soon as one character is outside it; a text that is split holds 153 or 67 per part. Characters of the extension table (€ [ ] { } ~ ^ \ |) and emoji take two places, and a character is never split over two parts. The counter reads 2 messages, 214 characters, Unicode beside a bar with one segment per message, and a line names what forced Unicode (an emoji, a curly apostrophe) so it can be taken out, and adds that emoji count as two characters each while one is in the text; Use plain characters swaps curly quotes, dashes, the ellipsis and special spaces for the standard ones through the browser's own editing, so undo brings them back. maxSegments is a soft limit: past it the counter, the bar and aria-invalid turn to the error colour and nothing is cut off. senderLabel is shown beside the label and is not counted. The number of messages is announced politely, only when it changes. countSms, plainText and the alphabet tables live in sms-message-field/sms.
